decisions.briefing: Markets pulled back today with the NASDAQ down 1.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.5%, putting conditions in risk-off territory. No new candidates were screened, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping the $289.29 cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling pressure hit growth-sensitive names harder, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500 by more than 2-to-1, a pattern typical of risk-off days where investors rotate out of higher-multiple tech stocks. The wider point drop in the NASDAQ suggests profit-taking or rate-sensitivity concerns weighed more on growth stocks than on the broader market. Without confirmed news catalysts available today, the move looks like a broad de-risking session rather than a single-stock-driven event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍受壓,納指跌幅1.1%,遠高於標普500的0.5%跌幅,反映資金從高估值科技股撤離,屬於典型的「risk-off」避險格局。納指跑輸大盤,顯示增長股對利率敏感度較高,或有獲利回吐壓力。今日未有確定的新聞觸發事件,這次調整看似屬於大市整體降低風險倉位,而非個別股份事件所致。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safety, often causing tech-heavy indexes like the NASDAQ to fall more than the broader market. The right response as a long-term investor isn't to panic-sell, but to avoid adding new risk and let existing stop-losses and profit targets do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」(避險)日子是指投資者普遍拋售增長股等風險較高的資產,轉向較安全的選擇,因此以科技股為主的納指跌幅往往大於大盤。長線投資者面對這類日子,正確做法不是恐慌性拋售,而是避免增加新風險,並讓既有的止蝕與獲利了結機制自動運作。
